title: ExecutionRequest
description: Platform-to-backend execution request. Encoding: unknown top-level fields MUST be tolerated by receivers (forward compatibility); timestamps are RFC3339 UTC ('Z'); identifiers are logical references resolved from the request and trusted local registration. backend_config_ns is a backend-specific namespace: the core validates nothing inside it and it never grants platform permissions. contract_version is the execution-contract version the sender speaks; receivers return version_conflict when it falls outside their support window.

input.description: Caller input payload; its structure is agreed per deployment, not by this contract.

deadline_at.description: RFC3339 UTC wall-clock deadline. Exceeding it yields outcome_unknown, never an automatic failure.

backend_config_ns.description: Vendor/backend namespace. Schema validation inside the namespace is the owning adapter's responsibility.
